<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{"body_md": "## Problem

Users cannot reconcile payment batches because supplier ledgers and invoices are missing or inaccessible, and uploaded claim documents fail to auto-assign to the correct supplier tasks, disrupting the workflow.

## Who is affected

- Cindermill Trade Cover, an account with £210000.0 in ARR and a renewal date of 2027-04-03, reports trouble seeing why a payment batch did not reflect in its supplier ledger [i:550f2b6c46f2b3dd].
- Wexmoor Motor, an account with £1950000.0 in ARR and a renewal date of 2027-06-30, reports being unable to locate matching documents in the system when reconciling a payment batch with suppliers' invoices [i:d93acbbda99a4ae5].
- Brackwater Homecover, an account with £610000.0 in ARR and a renewal date of 2027-10-10, reports that a batch of claims documents did not auto-assign to the right supplier tasks [i:f65321d912d263c2].
- In total, 3 accounts are affected, with 3 mentions across 1 route, all on the support route [i:550f2b6c46f2b3dd][i:d93acbbda99a4ae5][i:f65321d912d263c2].

## Evidence

- Cindermill Trade Cover raised the ledger reconciliation issue on 2026-09-09 via the support route [i:550f2b6c46f2b3dd].
- Wexmoor Motor raised the invoice reconciliation issue on 2026-10-30 via the support route [i:d93acbbda99a4ae5].
- Brackwater Homecover raised the auto-assignment issue on 2026-09-10 via the support route [i:f65321d912d263c2].
- The 3 accounts together represent £2770000.0 in ARR, with 0 renewals in the next 90 days [i:550f2b6c46f2b3dd][i:d93acbbda99a4ae5][i:f65321d912d263c2].

## Why now

- All 3 mentions arrived through the support route, and the most recent was on 2026-10-30 [i:d93acbbda99a4ae5].
- The affected accounts have renewal dates of 2027-04-03, 2027-06-30 and 2027-10-10, with 0 renewals in the next 90 days as of 2026-11-03 [i:550f2b6c46f2b3dd][i:d93acbbda99a4ae5][i:f65321d912d263c2].
- The evidence covers 3 accounts and 3 mentions; no insight in this set points the other way [i:550f2b6c46f2b3dd][i:d93acbbda99a4ae5][i:f65321d912d263c2].
", "citations": ["550f2b6c46f2b3dd", "d93acbbda99a4ae5", "f65321d912d263c2"]}
